title: Operating-Condition Normalization in C-MAPSS: Matched Historical Baselines, Multi-Seed Robustness, and Prognostic-Score Trade-offs
abstract: arXiv:2611.28759v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Operating-state changes can obscure turbofan degradation signals, but a reduction in remaining-useful-life (RUL) error after condition-wise standardization may reflect weaknesses of the comparison features instead of a unique benefit of normalization. A controlled retrospective audit examines NASA C-MAPSS FD002 and FD004 with engine-disjoint folds, raw condition identifiers, two constructions of causal history, early-life baselines, and continuous operating-setting correction. Ridge regression, random forests and XGBoost are compared under explicit training-engine-only fitting rules. The previously reported XGBoost FD004 terminal RMSE decreased from 30.38 to 29.08 cycles following six-condition standardization; however, raw sensor values accompanied by condition-matched histories and condition identifiers achieved 28.09 cycles, reversing the naive point estimate ranking, although the paired-engine interval spans zero. translated_title: C-MAPSS中的运行工况归一化：匹配历史基线、多种子鲁棒性与预测评分权衡
translated_abstract: 运行状态的变化可能掩盖涡扇发动机的退化信号，但按工况标准化后剩余寿命（RUL）误差的降低，可能反映的是对比特征自身的缺陷，而非归一化本身的独特优势。一项受控回溯审计检验了NASA C-MAPSS的FD002和FD004数据集，采用发动机不交叉的数据折、原始工况标识符、两种因果历史构建方式、早期寿命基线以及连续运行设定值校正，并在明确的仅使用训练发动机拟合规则下比较了岭回归、随机森林和XGBoost。此前报道的XGBoost在FD004上的终点RMSE经六工况标准化后从30.38降至29.08个循环；然而，结合工况匹配历史与工况标识符的原始传感器值达到了28.09个循环，逆转了朴素点估计的排名，尽管配对发动机的区间包含零（即差异不具统计显著性）。对于FD002，归一化……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文通过受控回溯审计发现，在C-MAPSS FD004上，使用原始传感器值并结合工况匹配历史与工况标识符的RUL预测误差（28.09循环）反而优于经过六工况标准化后的XGBoost结果（29.08循环），表明此前报道的归一化改进可能仅源于对比特征的缺陷，而非归一化本身的独特优势，且该差异在统计上并不显著。
en_tdlr: A controlled retrospective audit of NASA C-MAPSS FD002/FD004 shows that raw sensor values combined with condition-matched histories and condition identifiers achieve lower RUL error on FD004 (28.09 vs. 29.08 cycles RMSE) than condition-normalized XGBoost, indicating that previously reported gains from operating-condition normalization may merely reflect weaknesses of the comparison features rather than a unique benefit of normalization.
